exam: 115年專門職業及技術人員高等考試大地工程技師考試分階段考試(第一階段考試)、驗船師、第一次食品技師考試、高等暨普通考試消防設備人員考試、普通考試地政士、專責報關人員、保險代理人保險經紀人及保險公證人考試
subject: 關務英文

essays.text:
請將下列中文名詞譯為英文：（每小題 5 分，共 20 分）
①出口報單
②免驗通關
③預估發票
④離岸價格

請將下列各題之英文譯為中文：（每小題 15 分，共 30 分）
① In 2025, Taiwan’s Customs Administration launched a five-year DigitalCustoms Transformation Program to boost trade competitiveness andsecurity. This initiative focuses on four key pillars: reshaping theCustoms-Port-Trade (CPT) Single Window for better collaboration,developing intelligent services through data analytics, adopting cloudcomputing for operational flexibility, and strengthening cybersecurityand off-site backups.As a critical national infrastructure, the program aims to acceleratedigital transformation, creating a resilient and smart customs environmentthat supports Taiwan’s long-term economic development and internationaltrade efficiency.
② Following China’s new trade measures, Taiwan’s Ministry of Agriculturereaffirmed its strategy to diversify export markets and reduce relianceon an unpredictable Chinese market. Taiwan has successfully shiftedfocus to Japan, Singapore, and North America.Notably, fruit and vegetable exports to China plummeted from 73% in2019 to just 12.6% last year, with Japan now the top buyer of Taiwanesepineapples. While open to resuming trade, Taiwan remains cautious,prioritizing scientific management and improved cold-chain systems toensure long-term quality and stability in global markets.

mcq.q: “Substantial transformation”for the determination of the origin of general imported goods refers tocircumstances where the _____ -digit Customs Import Tariff heading of the goods produced afterprocessing or manufacturing differs from that of the raw materials. Alternatively, even if suchprocessing or manufacturing does not result in a change in the aforementioned tariff heading, it isrecognized if an essential manufacturing process has been completed or the value-added rate exceeds_____ %.
Since you did not meet the minimum order quantity, we will _____ USD500 for shipment value.
opts: overcharge
undercharge
surcharge
undervalue

mcq.q: Regarding the Incoterms 2020 trade terms, which of the following statements is incorrect?
opts: If the importer can negotiate a freight rate higher than the market level, it is advisable to importgoods under FOB or FCA terms.
If the importer cannot handle the export customs clearance procedures themselves or send someoneto do so, it is not advisable to purchase goods under EXW terms.
FAS and FOB terms are only applicable to sea or inland waterway transport.
DPU terms are applicable to sea, air, land, or multimodal transportation.

mcq.q: On February 28, 2026, a war broke out in Iran, and the Strait of Hormuz was partially blockaded,severely impacting global oil supplies. Which of the following items will NOT increase in price as aresult?
opts: War Risk Surcharge
Bunker Adjustment Fee
Freight Rate
Trade Promotion Service Fee

mcq.q: Regarding the“C”in the CPT terms and the“C”in the CFR terms as explained in Incoterms 2020,what is the difference between the two?
opts: The former refers to“carriage”; the latter refers to“cost”.
The former refers to“cost”; the latter refers to“carriage”.
The former refers to“carrier”; the latter refers to“carriage”.
The former refers to“carriage”; the latter refers to“carrier”.

mcq.q: If the bill of lading indicates “on board” but does not specify the loading date, only the date ofissuance, according to UCP 600, what date should be considered as the loading date?
opts: Date of bill of lading issuance
Actual loading date of the goods
One day before the date of bill of lading issuance
One day after the date of bill of lading issuance

mcq.q: When the goods arrive before the shipping documents sent through the bank, if the importer wantsto collect the goods in a timely manner, which of the following is NOT a workaround for the situationof“goods arriving before documents”?
opts: Guarantee for collection
Telegraphic release
Endorsement of a duplicate bill of lading
Collection at the ship’s side

mcq.q: If the carrier issues a “clean bill of lading,” under which of the following circumstances can theconsignee file a claim against the carrier?
opts: The goods are damaged during transportation due to natural disasters.
The goods were already damaged at the time of loading, but the bill of lading indicates they areclean.
The consignee failed to collect the goods within the agreed timeframe.
The damage to the goods is due to inherent defects in the packaging.

mcq.q: In cargo transport insurance, I.O.P. (Irrespective of Percentage) means:
opts: Insurance claims are paid in full by the insurer regardless of the percentage of loss.
Compensation is only provided for damages exceeding 20%.
Only applicable to specific types of goods.
Damages below 10% are not compensated.

mcq.q: According to The Reciprocal Trade Agreement signed between Taiwan and USA on Feb 2026, whichof the following is「TECRO」?
opts: Taiwan Economic and Climate Representative Office
Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office
Taiwan Economic and Cultural Representative Office
Taipei Economic and Customs Representative Office

mcq.q: Which of the following statements about Institute Cargo Clauses (A) (ICC(A)), Institute CargoClauses (B) (ICC(B)), and Institute Cargo Clauses (C) (ICC(C)) is incorrect?
opts: ICC(A) has the broadest coverage.
ICC(C) has the lowest insurance premium.
ICC(A), ICC(B), and ICC(C) do not cover war risks and strike risks.
ICC(B) and ICC(C) present all coverage items in a comprehensive manner.

mcq.q: Which of the following correctly describes the risk coverage of export insurance?
opts: The risk of the exporter being unable to collect payment.
The risk of export goods being damaged during transportation.
The risk of changes in the political situation of the exporting country.
The risk of the exporter being unable to deliver due to operational difficulties.

mcq.q: An Import Permit (I/P) is valid for six months. The expiration date of this six-month period is definedas the“date of shipment.”As long as the goods are loaded and shipped from the exporting countrybefore the permit’s expiration date (including the expiration date itself), the permit remains valid.Which of the following dates is considered the“date of shipment”?
opts: The date of issue stated on the invoice at the port of shipment
The date of issue stated on the bill of lading at the port of shipment
The date of export release
The date of export declaration

mcq.q: The buyer and seller agree to make payment via Documents Against Acceptance (D/A). When shouldthe importer make the payment for the goods?
opts: When the collecting bank presents the documentary bill of exchange to the importer
When the importer accepts the bill of exchange
When the importer presents the documents to the carrier to collect the goods
When the collecting bank presents the matured bill of exchange accepted by the importer

mcq.q: Regarding General Average, which of the following statements is correct?
opts: Only the shipping company is required to share the loss.
Only the cargo owners are required to share the loss.
The vessel, cargo, and freight beneficiaries share the loss proportionally.
The insurance company bears the full loss.

mcq.q: In international trade dispute resolution, which of the following statements regarding mediation andarbitration is incorrect?
opts: Mediation is conducted by a third party who assists both parties in reaching an agreement, and itis usually non-binding.
Arbitration occurs when both parties agree to have an arbitration institution or arbitrator make adecision, and the award is legally binding.
In arbitration proceedings, the parties cannot choose the arbitrator or arbitration institution, andthe court must appoint them.
Mediation can help both parties resolve disputes quickly and save litigation costs.

mcq.q: What does the MW0 code signify under the import and export goods regulations?
opts: Goods from mainland China are prohibited from importation.
Import and export are subject to control.
Goods from mainland China are permitted for import and export under certain conditions.
Import and export licenses are issued by the International Trade Administration.

mcq.q: Imported advertising materials and samples with a dutiable value (CIF) not exceeding NT$_____ areexempt from import duties.

Which section of the US Trade Act of 1974 authorizes the President to take all appropriate action toobtain the removal of any act of a foreign government that violates an international trade agreementthat restricts US commerce?
opts: Section 122
Section 121
Section 302
Section 301

mcq.q: The duty-payer shall declare imported good to Customs within A days following the arrival date ofgoods, in the case the duty-payer fails to apply for clearance within the time period, a late fee of Bper day shall be levied beginning from the date following the time period expires. Which of thefollowing one is correct?
opts: A is 10 days and B is NT$150
A is 15 days and B is NT$200
A is 10 days and B is NT$200
A is 15 days and B is NT$150

mcq.q: Which of the following Incoterms mean“the seller bears all risks involved in bringing the goods toand unloading them at the named place of destination”?
opts: Delivered Duty Paid
Delivered at Place Unloaded
Delivered at Place
Cost Insurance and Freight

mcq.q: Which of the following Incoterms mean “the seller delivers the goods and transfers the risk to thebuyer by handing them over to the carrier”?
opts: Cost and Freight
Delivered Duty Paid
Cost Insurance and Freight
Carriage and Insurance Paid To

mcq.q: A reference to an Incoterms 2020 rule in a sales contract clearly outlines the obligations of bothparties concerning several key topics, such as:
opts: Risks, profits, transportation and customs clearance
Risks, cost, transportation and security clearance
Risks, cost, transportation and customs clearance
Risks, carbon neutral, transportation and customs clearance

mcq.q: How many days should containers carrying maritime express consignments be dismantled anddelivered to the warehouse after being stored in the temporary container storage area?
opts: Two calendar days
Two working days
Three calendar days
Three working days

mcq.q: For imported goods subject to manual inspection, the number of cartons opened for examinationshall, in principle, be limited to less than _____ % of the total. However, if _____ cartons have alreadybeen opened and no discrepancies are found, further inspection may be waived.
There are several modes of import and export declarations used in Customs declarations. Which ofthe following is correct?
opts: G1 for Import, G5 for Export and F5 is Import for Free Trade Zone
G1 for Export, G5 for Import and F5 is Export for Free Trade Zone
G1 for Export, G5 for Export and F5 is Import for Free Trade Zone
G1 for Import, G5 for Export and F5 is Export for Free Trade Zone

mcq.q: Which government agency defines the types and formats of application forms for Certificates ofOrigin and Certificates of processing?
opts: The International Trade Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs
Customs Administration, Ministry of Finance
National Property Administration, Ministry of Finance
Intellectual Property Office, Ministry of Economic Affairs

mcq.q: According to the regulations regarding Certificates of Origin, which of the following will beconsidered a substantial transformation?
opts: Processing operations involving simple assembling
Procedures for concentration but do not change the original nature of the product
Preservation required for transportation
A raw material undergoes processing, resulting in an added value that exceeds 35%

mcq.q: What is the time basis for customs clearance operations at the logistics center?
opts: a working-hour basis
a 24-hour basis
a working day basis
a 12-hour basis

mcq.q: What are the differences between a logistics center and a bonded warehouse?
opts: Both the bonded warehouse and logistics center can simple processing the goods.
A logistics center can only perform reconditioning, while a bonded warehouse can simpleprocessing the goods.
A bonded warehouse can only perform reconditioning, while a logistics center can simpleprocessing the goods.
Both the bonded warehouse and logistics center cannot simple processing the goods.

mcq.q: Prior to the airplane or vessel’s arrival, how many hours should both air and sea forwarders submitthe import cargo manifest to Customs?
opts: For the air forwarder is 2 hours and for the sea forwarder is 6 hours
For the air forwarder is 2 hours and for the sea forwarder is 5 hours
For the air forwarder is 3 hours and for the sea forwarder is 6 hours
For the air forwarder is 3 hours and for the sea forwarder is 5 hours

mcq.q: What is the required guarantee deposit, a sea forwarder must submit for registration with Customs?
opts: The deposit amount is TWD 600,000, but for those certified with security and Safety AEO, it dropsto TWD 300,000.
The deposit amount is TWD 600,000, but for those certified with security and Safety AEO, it dropsto TWD 400,000.
The deposit amount is TWD 500,000, but for those certified with security and Safety AEO, it dropsto TWD 250,000.
The deposit amount is TWD 500,000, but for those certified with security and Safety AEO, it dropsto TWD 300,000.

mcq.q: When declaring online, if the import cargoes carried are not included in the cargo manifest, themanifest may be corrected at Customs with a justifiable reason within which time period after thevessel or plane has arrived?
opts: By shipping, within 120 hours, by air transport, within 72 hours
By shipping, within 72 hours, by air transport, also within 72 hours
By shipping, within 120 hours, by air transport, also within 36 hours
By shipping, within 72 hours, by air transport, also within 36 hours

mcq.q: The bonding operations of Science Parks(A), Bonded Warehouse(B) and Logistics Center(C) weresupervised by which government agency?
opts: A: National Science and Technology Council, B: Ministry of Finance, C: Ministry of Finance
A: Ministry of Finance, B: Ministry of Finance, C: Ministry of Finance
A: National Science and Technology Council, B: Ministry of Finance, C: National Science andTechnology Council
A: Ministry of Finance, B: National Science and Technology Council, C: Ministry of Finance

mcq.q: What preferential measures can Customs adopt for goods imported by a duty-payer with AEOSstatus?
opts: Goods with a declared Customs Value less than NTD 10 million may be released withoutdocumentation examination.
Goods with a declared Customs Value more than NTD 10 million may be released without bothdocumentation examination and physical inspection.
Goods with a declared Customs Value less than NTD 100 million may be released withoutdocumentation examination.
Goods with a declared Customs Value more than NTD 100 million may be released without bothdocumentation examination and physical inspection.

mcq.q: Which government agency is responsible for the“Act for the Establishment and Management of FreeTrade Zones”and the“Regulations Governing Customs Clearance for Goods in Free Trade Zones”?
opts: The first is the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the second is the Ministry of Finance.
The first is the Ministry of Economics and the second is the Ministry of Finance.
The first is the Ministry of Transportation and Communications and the second is the Ministry ofFinance.
The first is the Ministry of Finance and the second is also the Ministry of Finance.

mcq.q: What is the term commonly used to refer to the International Convention on the simplification andharmonization of customs procedures, which was adopted by the Customs Co-operation Council in1973?
opts: Kyoto Convention
Tokyo Convention
Paris Convention
Brussel Convention

mcq.q: According to Article 18 of the Customs Act, when the concerned duty-payer provides a pre-entrydeclaration along with all required documentation, which imported air cargo may be examined andreleased alongside the aircraft by Customs with special consideration?
opts: frozen foods, computer chips, live animals and hazardous goods
fresh foods, perishable goods, electronic equipment and auto parts
fresh foods, perishable goods, live animals and hazardous goods
Frozen food, computer chips, electronic equipment and hazardous goods

mcq.q: Import samples shall be retained for _____ from the date the sample receipt is issued. In contrast,export samples shall be retained for _____ from the date the sample receipt is issued.
opts: 1 month；5 days
2 months；10 days
3 months；15 days
6 months；30 days

mcq.q: According to the“ATA Carnet Regulations”established by our country, which of the following goodsare NOT eligible for temporary admission?
opts: Professional equipment and apparatus
Perishable goods
Goods for display or use at international trade exhibitions or conferences
Imported commercial samples for display or demonstration purposes to solicit business
